scope: primary multi-seed LSTM versus GRU comparison

evaluation.secondary_metric: test cross-entropy in nats per target token
evaluation.aggregation: arithmetic mean and sample standard deviation across three seeds
evaluation.token_policy: include characters and eos; exclude bos and pad
evaluation.test_policy: evaluate each seed only after validation-based checkpoint selection; do not tune from test

reporting.generation_checkpoint: seed 42 fixed examples, not selected by generation quality
required_limitations: different LSTM and GRU parameter counts
surface-form constraints do not guarantee poetic quality

audit_note: Seed 42 test results were produced before this multi-seed protocol was frozen. Seeds 43 and 44 and all aggregation rules were frozen before those runs; no hyperparameters are changed from seed 42.
